method: Read-only JSONL snapshot, ZIP/lxml source-vs-edited comparison, plus existing repository source inspection. No Word calls or GUI observations; no DOCX or repository edits. Existing PDF reports are untouched.

codeEvidence.meaning: inks is an authoritative list; remove_inks deletes all editor aidocs-ink runs before insertion.
SaveOptions.inks=Some schedules RemoveInks then InsertInk for each supplied entry.
Existing test documents authoritative-list and repeated-save-does-not-accumulate semantics. Test was read, not executed.
